description: Reads the note an incoming 1V per octave voltage names and puts out the voltage set for that note, along with a trigger on one of twelve channels.

params.text: Sets the voltage the CV output carries while the input is on C, -5V to +10V.
Sets the voltage the CV output carries while the input is on C#, -5V to +10V.
Sets the voltage the CV output carries while the input is on D, -5V to +10V.
Sets the voltage the CV output carries while the input is on D#, -5V to +10V.
Sets the voltage the CV output carries while the input is on E, -5V to +10V.
Sets the voltage the CV output carries while the input is on F, -5V to +10V.
Sets the voltage the CV output carries while the input is on F#, -5V to +10V.
Sets the voltage the CV output carries while the input is on G, -5V to +10V.
Sets the voltage the CV output carries while the input is on G#, -5V to +10V.
Sets the voltage the CV output carries while the input is on A, -5V to +10V.
Sets the voltage the CV output carries while the input is on A#, -5V to +10V.
Sets the voltage the CV output carries while the input is on B, -5V to +10V.

inputs.text: The note to look at, clamped to -5V through +10V; only the position within the octave matters, not which octave.
A rising edge past 2V sends a trigger out of the channel belonging to the note currently at the CV input.

outputs.text: The voltage set for whichever note the input is on.
Twelve channels of trigger, one per note of the octave; a 10V pulse 1ms long comes out of the channel for the note at the input.

notes: Nothing comes out unless a cable is patched to the CV input. With that jack empty the CV output holds 0V and no trigger ever fires.
The trigger is held back for five samples after it arrives, so a note voltage changing at the same moment as the trigger is read first.
menu: Output Trigger On Note Change — fires the trigger for a note when the incoming voltage moves onto it, without needing a trigger patched.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.1:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
